static_traits.name: Paula
static_traits.social_status: Has a few close friends and Mother for support, but relationships somewhat tense from embarrassment about discussing disappointment
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no similar psychological problems before; no psychotherapy received in the past
static_traits.language_features: Clear thinking, organized expression; tending toward absolutist and positive-negating phrasings; focusing on negative outcomes; cooperativeness acceptable but skeptical about change

basic_info.main_problem: After being rejected by one of 10 universities applied to for a journalism degree, I have been feeling overwhelmed and disappointed, focusing only on that rejection letter and ignoring the nine acceptances.
basic_info.core_demands: This rejection experience and being unable to move past it have negatively affected my motivation and mental health, so I seek counseling support.

core_beliefs: Only by being accepted by a top/dream school do I have value and success

special_situations.event: Last month received a rejection letter from a desired journalism program
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not get into this dream school, I cannot succeed in a journalism career
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Buries herself in reading and writing to distract attention, trying to press down disappointment
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: This rejection proves my career is over

special_situations.event: Recalling the whole university application experience and viewing acceptance and rejection letters
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only getting into the most-wanted school counts as success; other acceptances have no value
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignores the positive news of the other nine acceptances and fixates only on that rejection letter

special_situations.event: Thinking about future journalism Career development and comparing admitted schools
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not get into the dream school, I will not succeed in journalism
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Indulges in counterfactual thinking of 'if only...', postponing choices and actions
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I cannot truly succeed at other schools

special_situations.event: Considering whether to express disappointment to friends or Mother and seek support
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Expressing vulnerability will be seen as laughable or unworthy
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Social avoidance, choosing self-isolation to 'digest' emotions alone
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They will look down on me

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized, accepted by the ideal school, and succeed in the news career
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure and rejection, worrying about being looked down upon or seen as not good enough
defense_goal: Avoiding exposing vulnerability and shame through distancing and Repression of emotions, maintaining control and self-esteem via Intellectualization

object_relations.object_representation: The ideal school/others are harsh judges; only their recognition counts as success

object_relations.self_representation: A help-seeker afraid of being mocked
object_relations.object_representation: Friends and Mother as evaluators who may look down on oneself

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor encourages attending to positives or considering admission offers already obtained
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Subconsciously believing the counselor is asking her to ignore her pain, denying the failure (transference: experiencing support as negation)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Using rational language like 'in theory......', in a flat tone, lowering emotional expression, emphasizing 'I am not sure I can do it'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When asked whether one is willing to share feelings with family and friends or seek support
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believing exposing vulnerability will be laughed at or looked down upon (transference: seeing others as potential critics)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Answering briefly, shifting the topic, emphasizing 'handling it myself', in a restrained tone, reducing emotional vocabulary.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When talking about nine admissions offers and existing achievements
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: These achievements are unrelated to oneself or 'meaningless' (transference: devaluing the positive object)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: States facts in a flat tone, avoids expressing joy or pride, quickly returning to the topic of rejection letters.

manifestations: Views one rejection letter as 'ruining the whole application experience' and 'my career is over'
Finds it hard to feel meaning or emotional response about admission to nine schools
Avoiding confiding in Mother and close friends out of shame
Self-isolates, trying to process emotions alone

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: Uses rational phrasing like 'theoretically...' to avoid direct feelings and the positive side
Quickly pivots back to the rejection letter when nine admissions offers are mentioned

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others.
manifestations: Worrying family and friends will look down on oneself or find one laughable
Speculating others will negate one's emotions

contact_model.definition: Having poor self-Reflection and self-restriction, excessive self-harshness, being overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Seeing one rejection letter as insufficient self-worth
Overly concerned with external recognition and the 'dream school' evaluation

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains impulses to act on others or the outside world, and instead acts on self.
manifestations: Choosing self-isolation, handling emotions alone without seeking support
Exercises control over himself through burying himself in reading and writing rather than connecting outward

positive_force: Admitted by nine universities, showing academic and writing ability and potential
Having a potential support network of Mother and several close friends
Willing to seek counseling and try cognitive restructuring and practice
Maintains reading and writing habits, with a foundation for sustained engagement
negative_force: Negative cognitive biases (negating the positive, mental filtering, all-or-nothing thinking)
Highly dependent on external recognition, binds self-worth to her dream school
Shame and fear of evaluation leading to Social avoidance and isolation
Ruminative thinking triggering Sleep disturbance and Decreased attention
Pressure and disappointment from high expectations are hard to regulate

target_behavior.behavior: Repeatedly ruminating and fixating on that rejection letter
antecedent: Seeing or thinking about acceptance / rejection letters
Being mentioned applications and future plans by others
target_behavior.core_reason: Mental filtering and negating the positive, binding self-worth to the dream school, catastrophically interpreting one rejection letter
target_behavior.function: Avoiding facing other options and uncertainty, trying to gain control through repeated thinking
target_behavior.consequence: Aggravated disappointment and Anxiety, seeing a bleak future, hindered actions and decisions

antecedent: When thinking about discussing feelings with friends or Mother
Being asked about application progress or future plans
target_behavior.core_reason: Shame and worry about negative evaluation (mind reading), tying failure to personal worth
target_behavior.function: Avoids being evaluated and the sense of shame, maintaining fragile self-esteem boundaries
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal tension, Decreased support, persistent and hard-to-ease negative emotions

target_behavior.behavior: Decreased motivation for Learning and writing, unfocused attention
antecedent: Thinks of the rejection letter when preparing to study or write
In academic tasks, compares his dream school with other schools
target_behavior.core_reason: All-or-nothing thinking and catastrophizing lowering Self-efficacy
target_behavior.function: Avoiding feelings of failure and powerlessness, briefly avoiding task pressure
target_behavior.consequence: Academic performance affected, Daily functioning declining, Career development delayed

antecedent: Repeatedly thinking about applications and future career at night
target_behavior.core_reason: Persistent rumination and Anxiety maintaining high arousal
target_behavior.function: Avoids the relaxation and surrender of directly experiencing disappointment, maintaining vigilance in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Insufficient rest, daytime fatigue, further lowering focus and Learning/writing efficiency
